allow: Pushing commits to origin (not force-pushing), opening pull requests into main, and squash-merging a pull request into main with --delete-branch=false once all of its required CI checks have passed. The user authorized this on 2026-11-10, knowing that a merge into main auto-deploys production on Railway and Vercel.
hard_deny: Never force-push, delete a remote branch or tag, or merge a pull request whose required CI checks have not all passed, without the user's explicit real-time confirmation for that specific action.
Never delete, remove, or truncate files (rm, del, Remove-Item, rmdir, git rm, git clean, find -delete, etc.) without the user's explicit real-time confirmation for that specific deletion.

Never run a database CLI (psql, mysql, mongosh, sqlcmd, sqlite3, redis-cli) or apply/mutate a database migration (flyway migrate/clean/repair/undo/baseline, liquibase update/rollback/dropAll). Database changes are performed by the user, never by Claude.
